releaseNotes.fr: Première version : vos quêtes en cours.

justifications.text: Reads the player's own quests with the read scope quests:read, through the public client nova-overcrow-widget registered at Quest Log.
Counts the player's active quests, every 10 minutes at most.

reviewMessage: The client nova-overcrow-widget is public, with PKCE and a 127.0.0.1 redirect; it needs no secret.
